instrument_caveats: 36 of the 82 closed obligations carry NO class label (the older G001-G0xx block). A first pass defaulted them to POSITIVE because no negative keyword matched, which inflated every rate. They are EXCLUDED here and the prior is computed on the 46 labelled ones only.

POSITIVE/NEGATIVE is keyword-classified from status lines I wrote myself. It is a coarse self-labelling, not an independent adjudication, and the per-class counts are small enough (3 to 11) that only the extremes should be read as signal.

the_prior.strongest_signal: WILD is 4 closed, 4 NEGATIVE -- a 100% refutation rate. Every wild mechanism this ledger proposed (cross-architecture, attractor compilation, conditional depth, MoE grammar adjacents) died on measurement. THEORY is 2 of 3 negative. By tier, V3 refutes at 43% against V2's 13%.
the_prior.policy_it_implies: Order proposals by tier, not by ambition. V2 KERNEL and REPRESENTATION work paid at 62-82%; V3 WILD paid at zero. A search policy trained on this ledger should spend its budget on V2 mechanisms and demand a precondition measurement before any V3 one -- which is exactly what G079 turned out to be for G077/G078/G080.
the_prior.the_cheapest_closures_were_not_new_exper: Two patterns dominated this session's closures. FIRST, building the missing BASELINE rather than the missing feature: the (R,1) kernels were built to settle G091's confound and incidentally made G094's hypothesis testable for the first time. SECOND, assembling existing receipts: G095, G096 and G097 were closed with no new measurement at all. A search policy that proposes mechanisms is optimising the wrong thing; the ledger says propose BASELINES and CROSS-CHECKS.
the_prior.and_the_measurement_method_is_the_risk: Seven method defects were caught this session against zero artifact defects. A prior that ranks MECHANISMS without ranking INSTRUMENTS would have shortened nothing, because the failures were never in which mechanism was tried.

verify_not_met.why: The verify measures this as TIME-TO-FRONTIER on a deliberately different architecture -- the Odyssey test. There is one architecture on this machine and one device, so the prior can be EXTRACTED but not VALIDATED. A prior that has not shortened a real search has not been demonstrated, and that is not claimed.
verify_not_met.missing_input: a second architecture to run the frontier search against, with the prior on and off
